collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A friend knows two people like each other but neither will say: tell them, or stay out of it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) knows two things that nobody else knows: that (subject.his/her) friend (friend) is in love with the village's best fisher, and that the fisher is in love with (friend). Neither of them will say a word. (subject) is going quietly mad watching them. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) arranges, very casually, for (friend) and the fisher to be the only two people mending nets on the beach one afternoon. Then (subject.he/she) walks away. By evening, they are walking along the shore together. (friend) knows exactly what (subject) did, and pretends to be angry for almost a whole day.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides it is not (subject.his/her) secret to tell. It takes another three months. Then one day (friend) comes running, breathless, to say the fisher has finally spoken. (subject) acts very surprised.
